top_fix: LCP remains above 4 s on three pages (homepage 3913 ms, note-structurer 4401 ms, screenshot-to-primevue 4704 ms) — preload each page's hero/LCP element with `<link rel="preload" fetchpriority="high">`, serve all images as WebP at display dimensions, and defer non-critical JS to reduce TBT; this is the single change most likely to push all three sub-85 performance pages above the threshold.
